# Experiment 6: In-Context Algebra checkpoint on the fingerprint (auto-generated by analyze6.py)

Adapter validation on the model's own distribution: held-out final fact at k=200 0.973, k=50 0.832, k=20 0.660 (see PREREGISTRATION.md).
Upstream protocol replica (fresh sequences, not the authors' cached 512-sequence set): 0.959; released checkpoints on the same 1024 sequences: best 0.959, 100000 0.960, 40000 0.975, 20000 0.971, 10000 0.835. Independent forward pass vs the adapter: argmax agreement 1.000 on 3200 answer positions, max |logit diff| 1.9e-04 (validate_ckpts.json).
